description: The place where a unit of work starts and ends, which belongs on the service method that implements one use case.
The wrapper Spring puts around a bean to open, commit or roll back a transaction around calls that come from other beans.
A call from one method to another on the same object, which skips the proxy so the target's @Transactional has no effect.
The rule that a RuntimeException or Error rolls back by default while a checked exception commits, adjustable with rollbackFor.
The setting that decides whether a method joins the running transaction, as REQUIRED does, or runs in a new one, as REQUIRES_NEW does.
A transaction marked readOnly = true, which is a hint to the driver and makes Hibernate skip dirty checking, not a write guard.
Concurrency control with a @Version field that makes an UPDATE fail when another transaction changed the row first.
